description: Compute the monthly repayment, total interest and total cost for a hypothetical loan from an interest rate you supply (standard amortisation). Use this for "what-if" rates; for the real rates of a specific package the borrower has chosen, use `calculate_package_schedule` instead.

interestRate.description: Hypothetical annual interest rate held for the whole tenure, as a percentage (e.g. 3.5 = 3.5%, not 0.035).

name: calculate_mortgage_repayment

firstYearInterest.description: Interest paid in year 1, in SGD.

firstYearPrincipal.description: Principal repaid in year 1, in SGD.

halfPaidOffMonth.description: Month at which half the principal is repaid.

interestPercentage.description: Interest as a fraction of total paid (0.3 = 30%).

principalPercentage.description: Principal as a fraction of total paid (0.7 = 70%).

totalInterest.description: Total interest over the tenure, in SGD.

totalPaid.description: Total of all payments (principal + interest), in SGD.

title: Mortgage repayment calculator
